newsitem.title: BELGIUM: CERA STUDYING BANQUE INDOSUEZ BELGIQUE - NEWSPAPER.
newsitem.headline: CERA STUDYING BANQUE INDOSUEZ BELGIQUE - NEWSPAPER.

text.p: Belgium's Cera Bank is studying the possibility of buying Banque Indosuez Belgique, financial daily newspaper L'Echo, citing a well informed source, reported on Wednesday.

The newspaper said Cera, Belgium's sixth largest bank, confirmed the existence of a study into Indosuez Belgique but declined to comment on its state of development and noted that it regularly looked at other banks.
L'Echo said Indosuez Belgique's chief executive Jean-Francois Marchal declined to comment on rumours, but said banks had to evolve in the context of a changing market.
Indosuez Belgique is mainly involved on the financial markets and with small and medium-sized enterprises.
Cera, on the other hand, is a savings bank with some 1,000 branches.
